plan_vitrine.name: Plan vitrine
plan_vitrine.description: An enterable glass room around a five-by-five numbered plan. The panes have no colliders; the plan has a continuous floor. With active VR controllers, entry mounts two drawing pens and exit removes them. The space_grid pair compares a freely sampled cyan trace with an amber trace rounded to local one-metre X/Z addresses, retaining hand height. The legacy space_time pair compares spatial drawing with a time-domain trace. Desktop visitors can walk the plan but receive no mounted pens. Marks linger briefly after exit.
plan_vitrine.qfep_connection: Two recording rules admit different movements into their traces. In Grid the floor supplies shared addresses while the hand can still move within them; what a record retains becomes available for comparison.
interactions: walk in through any face; the lit opening shows the intended front
VR only: both controllers gain a draw_dot on entry and lose it on exit

parameters.span_m: Outer face to outer face, metres (default 5.0, matching simulation_grid's walkable collider)
parameters.wrap_plan: Build simulation_grid inside the box (default true)
parameters.linger_s: Seconds the marks hang after the visitor steps out (default 6.0)
parameters.left_ink: Ink name for the free pen: magenta, cyan, amber, lime, white (default cyan)
parameters.right_ink: Ink name for the right-hand pen (default amber)
parameters.pen_pair: space_time (legacy default) or space_grid (Point_Line_Grid: sampled space / local one-metre X/Z rounding, continuous height)

plan_vitrine.capacity: DRAW with two incompatible pens at once
